facts.fact: The Harare Institute of Technology says its InstaPark parking management system is in use in 15 municipalities, with no total of municipalities given.
HIT says InstaPark lets councils collect 100 percent of parking revenue directly instead of through joint ventures with foreign firms; no register of payers is described.

systems.platform: 38 modules incl. financial management, billing, receipting, procurement, housing, asset control, land management
systems.tiers: several local authorities; the document says many councils implement only peripheral modules and avoid the core ones

systems.owner: Harare Institute of Technology (vendor, annual licence fee)

note: LADS states modules but no use of its billing or receipting modules by a counted number of councils, so it gives no fact.
